source.plan: research/reports/w34_rebalance_plan.md (measured at f9de8e2c, before the W32 ingest)

builder_rule.change: Per-stage caps (`caps`) replace the flat 3/6. Selection order is unchanged, so the pre-W34 production items stay a prefix. Floor rule: production grows toward its stage cap only while the fluency block keeps the item count it has at 3/6.

caps_rule: Re-derived 2026-09-27 on the post-W32 path (the plan's caps left 7 stages 0.2-0.9 pt out of band). Per stage, over P 3-40 and F 6-60 at the builder's own selection: never a (stage, strand) further from R78's budget than at 3/6; then the lowest P+F with the worst strand within 9.5 pt (0.5 pt margin), else within 10, else (arrival) the lowest worst distance.
